author: Inside Edition
description: "Team Moms" is a new reality show from executive producer Kim Kardashian. The show features the overbearing moms of teen baseball stars at a prestigious Arizona academy. With their kids on the field, the hovering helicopter parents can't stop competing either, with each other. "Team Moms: Baseball" starts streaming Thursday on Paramount Plus.
title: New Reality Show 'Team Moms' Features Overbearing Parents Of Teen Baseball Stars

author: Inside Edition
description: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu was speaking at the United Nations as police searched for three men seen climbing out of a manhole close to the Manhattan hotel where he usually stays. Security expert Dave Sarni showed Inside Edition how vulnerable the sewer system is. The NYPD believes the incident may not be linked to terrorism but to an organized group of so-called 'Mole Men' who scour the sewer system for lost valuables and scrap metal.
title: Who Are The Men Climbing Out Of A Manhole Near Netanyahu's NYC Hotel?

author: Inside Edition
description: There was plenty of emotion in court today, as the other woman in the "American Idol" murder trial returned to the stand. Prosecutors in Miami County, Ohio say former pastor and "Idol" contestant Caleb Flynn killed his wife earlier this year and tried to cover it up, so that he could be with his mistress. That woman, Alleigha Botner, testified that she didn't go to church for fear she would run into Flynn's wife.
title: Former Mistress in 'American Idol' Murder Trial Cries On The Stand

author: Inside Edition
description: A family from Tennessee was about to board a cruise ship in Miami, Florida when they were caught in the crossfire of a shooting. They found themselves taking cover, crouching behind a police car, as bullets flew. Thankfully, they were unhurt, and after their brush with danger, they were able to board their cruise today. They told Inside Edition's Ann Mercogliano they're hoping the rest of their journey is drama-free.
title: Tennessee Family Caught In Miami Crossfire

author: Inside Edition
description: Bats! The sight of them may send some people running in the other direction, but not this group. The Cork Bat Group based in Ireland is a volunteer organization dedicated to making sure these creatures thrive. They run a rehabilitation program to nurse injured bats back to health. They then study them and release them back into the wild where they are needed. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: These Crusaders Are Helping Bats
